answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shortened onboarding flow: it improved completion, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, supporting durable qualified revenue without relying on price concessions. Do not use promotional pricing as the primary response: the recovered discount experiment produced a 12% 30-day retention decline despite acquisition and initial revenue gains, creating material downstream-value risk. This may not fully neutralize competitor-driven price churn, so uncertainty remains.
